title: Go-to-market readiness checklist for initial pilot journeys
creator: Marisol Rivera
description: Objective: Prepare a concise, operational readiness checklist that coordinates Product, Eng, Design, Sales, CS, and Legal for the initial pilot journeys (first 10 pilot accounts). Deliverables: 1) A single-page checklist for pre-launch signoff per account; 2) a cross-team playbook with owners and escalation paths; 3) a templated feedback capture and triage flow that feeds into Optimize and the release backlog. This ticket drives alignment and artifacts needed before the pilot activation wave.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist template created and reviewed by Eng/Design/Sales/CS/Legal
At least 3 pilot accounts scheduled with start dates and assigned owners
Runbook for escalation and rollback validated in tabletop exercise
Feedback intake form and triage flow integrated with Zendesk and a single GitHub label for engineering follow-ups
Telemetry and dashboard views (latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens) are wired to the console and smoke-tested
success_metrics: >80% of pilot accounts complete Day-7 health check with no critical issues
Avg time to acknowledge pilot-reported defects < 24 hours
Top-10 pilot prompts covered by at least one eval set in Optimize
Rollout decisions (proceed/hold/rollback) captured within 48 hours of threshold breach
rollout_steps: 1) Finalize checklist and share with cross-functional reviewers (Mar 5)
2) Assign account leads and schedule kickoff calls (Mar 6-10)
3) Execute a tabletop: simulate a latency spike and a model-quality regression (Mar 11)
4) Open pilot windows in batches of 3 accounts, observe 7 days, then evaluate metrics and feedback (Mar 12-24)
5) Compile lessons and decide expansion or rollback (Mar 25-27)
communication_plan: Pre-launch: one-pager sent to execs, ops, and customer success (owner: PM)
Weekly: digest to pilot cohort with health snapshot and action items (owner: CS)
Ad-hoc: immediate incident channel on Slack + post-incident learning doc (owner: Eng/Infra)
Post-pilot: consolidated report + recommendation for GA or further pilots (owner: PM)
feedback_loop: Capture: standardized feedback form linked in pilot onboarding and daily check-ins
Triage: CS tags high/medium/low and assigns to engineering via GitHub issue with label 'pilot-feedback'
Prioritization: Weekly review by PM with Engineering + Research for quality regressions
Closing: CS updates pilot account and records resolution in the playbook
monitoring_and_alerting: Dashboard: pilot-specific view (latency p95, token cost, error rate, requests/min)
Alerts: SLO breaches trigger PagerDuty with auto-notification to pilot-owner channel
Smoke tests: post-deploy smoke-runner validates generation and embeddings for a canonical prompt set
Data retention: upload pilot telemetry to an analysis bucket for 90 days
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Model-quality regression undetected by automated checks -> Mitigation: add canary evals and human spot checks
Risk: Unexpected cost spikes from test traffic -> Mitigation: set hard quota and cost-alert thresholds per account
Risk: Customer data ingress into logs -> Mitigation: verify PII scrubber is enabled and KMS keys are configured
Risk: Lack of cross-team ownership for fixes -> Mitigation: require named owners on every checklist item before signoff
